title: Bias of the generator density
statement: Let $n$ and $[0m\ell$ be natural numbers with $[0m\ell\ne 0$. The probability density on $[0m\mathbb{F}_2^{n\ell}$ obtained by choosing two elements of the binary extension field of degree $[0m\ell$ independently and uniformly, then outputting their field-pairing generator using the basis-expanded family, has every nonzero Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $[0m n/2^\ell$.
